review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature mouth part (PROPOSED): a lamprey-like oral disc on a short funnel, with a frilled lip and three rings of small hooked teeth round a dark throat; gapes and flares on shape keys.

textures.name: T_PartMouthSucker_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartMouthSucker_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

handles.meaning: the disc and throat open, the throat about 70% wider and the teeth riding out with it
the rim spread about 1.2 cm wider and flatter, as when it latches on

part_rules.handles_note: Both keys are on MouthSucker, MouthSuckerDisc and MouthSuckerTeeth with the same names; the runtime sets them together. Each tooth rides rigidly with the point of the disc it is rooted on.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

review_notes.gate1_shape: pass: a short trumpet-shaped funnel about 5.5 cm out of the skin flaring to a fleshy bead of lip scalloped into ten soft ruffled lobes (about 11 cm across); inside it a dished disc with three distinct concentric rings of small cones (16, 12, 8) all hooking in toward a round throat. It reads apart from the maw (flat rolled ring, fourteen long fangs) by the standing funnel, the scalloped rim and the many small teeth. H1_Gape opens the throat and spreads the inner rings; H2_Flare spreads the rim wide and flat, the teeth riding with the disc. Iterated: the first rim was a sharp zigzag crown on a thin cup wall.
review_notes.gate2_materials: pass: three finishes - wet sea-green lip skin with ring wrinkles and small round papillae on the bead, a low-chroma plum disc darkening to near black down the throat, and amber horn teeth; the lip-to-disc border is a clean line (the disc is its own mesh tucked under the bead; the first build's single mesh decimated it into a sawtooth).
review_notes.gate3_neutral_light: pass: under the neutral white rig the bead's highlight reads its roll, the teeth stand out against the dark disc, the throat stays dark without crushing the disc; no clipping.
review_notes.gate4_godot: needs revision: orientation only, from the shared forward_cone frame (every existing mouth and eye points the same way; not this art). In the creature editor on the angler (maw swapped in memory, docs/evidence/credit-more-parts/after_angler_mouth_sucker.jpg) it loads, seats on the snout tip without floating or deep clipping, sits in scale with the head and keeps its sea-green lip, plum disc and amber teeth, but its opening faces up. With the frame fix previewed (more_parts_shots.gd --cone-fix-preview, conefix_angler_mouth_sucker.jpg) the funnel juts forward from the snout and the toothed disc faces ahead, reading as a lamprey's sucker in the front and close views.

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_more_creature_parts.py, with helpers from tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
